# reselling_database_user (Resource)

A user of a `reselling_database` server. The password is generated by the API and returned only once; it is kept in the state as a sensitive value. Change `rotate` to any new value to rotate the password. After an import the password is unknown until it is rotated. Import with `database_id/user_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_database_user" "app" {
  database_id = reselling_database.shop.id
  username    = "shop_app"
  rotate      = "2026-11" # change to rotate the password

  grants = [{
    db_id     = reselling_database_db.shop.id
    privilege = "owner"
  }]
}

output "db_password" {
  value     = reselling_database_user.app.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Id of the database server.
- `username` (String) Starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

### Optional

- `grants` (Attributes Set) Privileges per logical database. Changed in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `rotate` (String) Free-form trigger: whenever the value changes, the password is rotated (for example a date or `timestamp()` kept in a variable).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password as returned on creation or the last rotation.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `db_id` (String) Id of a `reselling_database_db`.
- `privilege` (String) For example `owner`, `read_write` or `read_only`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The password is unknown after an import until it is rotated.
terraform import reselling_database_user.app <database_id>/<user_id>
```
